The '''Omar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Omar]].

It was here that Imperial manufacturing plants owned and operated by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] were used to construct [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avengers]]. Unfortunately for the Empire, the rogue [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]] launched [[Attack on Omar|attacks]] at all the [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility|Deep Space Manufacturing Facilities]] and utterly neutralized them, all but crippling the Empire's ability to produce the TIE Avenger. However, the attacks did come at a high price thanks to [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
